evals.name: multi-workstream-happy-path
evals.prompt: Run plan on the docs directory at evals/files/multi-ws/.
evals.expected_output: Complete plan artifacts: FEATURES.md with 2+ workstreams, feature specs for every feature, workstream roadmaps for every workstream, and a project-level ROADMAP.md aggregating all workstreams.
assertions: FEATURES.md exists in the docs directory
FEATURES.md contains a workstream summary table with at least 2 workstreams
FEATURES.md contains feature tables with codes matching the {WS}-{N} pattern (e.g., PLT-1, UI-2)
For every feature code listed in FEATURES.md, a corresponding file exists at {WS}/{FC}/{FC}.md
Every feature spec file contains the sections: Goal, Status, Deliverables (as a table), and Exit Criteria (as a bullet list)
Every feature spec has between 2 and 10 deliverables in its Deliverables table
For every workstream code in FEATURES.md, a {WS}/{WS}-roadmap.md file exists
Every workstream roadmap contains a milestone summary table that references only feature codes belonging to that workstream
No feature code appears in a workstream roadmap it does not belong to
ROADMAP.md exists in the docs directory
ROADMAP.md contains a schedule table with one column per workstream
ROADMAP.md references all workstream roadmaps
The agent printed a completion summary listing all artifact file paths
The completion summary reports no failures

evals.name: single-workstream-simplification
evals.expected_output: Complete plan artifacts for a single-workstream project: FEATURES.md with 1 workstream, feature specs for every feature, and ROADMAP.md written as a workstream roadmap (no project-level aggregation).
assertions: FEATURES.md exists in the docs directory
FEATURES.md contains exactly 1 workstream in the summary table
For every feature code listed in FEATURES.md, a corresponding file exists at {WS}/{FC}/{FC}.md
Every feature spec file contains the sections: Goal, Status, Deliverables (as a table), and Exit Criteria (as a bullet list)
ROADMAP.md exists in the docs directory
ROADMAP.md is structured as a workstream roadmap (has milestone summary table with feature references) not as a project-level roadmap (no cross-workstream schedule table)
The agent's output mentions single workstream simplification or skipping the project roadmap stage
No separate {WS}/{WS}-roadmap.md file exists — the roadmap lives at ROADMAP.md directly

evals.name: minimal-viable-input
evals.expected_output: A proportionally small set of plan artifacts: FEATURES.md with 2-5 features in 1 workstream, feature specs for each, and ROADMAP.md. No over-generation or hallucinated structure beyond what the tiny input warrants.
assertions: FEATURES.md exists and lists at least 2 but no more than 5 features
FEATURES.md lists exactly 1 workstream (proportional to the tiny input scope)
For every feature code in FEATURES.md, a corresponding feature spec file exists
Every feature spec has between 2 and 10 deliverables
ROADMAP.md exists
No output files are empty or contain only placeholder text
The total number of milestones in ROADMAP.md is no more than 3 (proportional to scope)
